svg.title: Multimodal annotation pipeline
svg.desc: Format readers retain episode cameras, state, sensors and task context. Field interpretation and recording checks prepare the episode. Recording type, model and task scope determine sampling and request limits. Model inputs contain timestamped camera grids, task context and checks, with optional task-based image resolution. The selected VLM annotates behavior and can select and inspect episode sensor evidence through a separate optional loop. Request chunks rejoin on the original timeline for video overlays and JSON exports. Input verification, receipts, spending caps and verified resume apply across the run.

g.aria-label: Sample camera frames into timestamped grids.
Include task context and recording checks.
Preserve field meanings, units and timing limits.
Return one episode on the original timeline, with gaps and failures reported.
